By accepting the Wikipedia data from Step 11 as the sole truth and ignoring the contradictory evidence found earlier in Step 9, the Planner synthesized an incorrect final answer (1946) instead of the correct one (1944). This represents a failure in data integration and verification, where the agent did not reconcile the discrepancy between the initial search results and the specific page load.
